extraction_notes: Identity: LCSC C19077490 corresponds to 1SMA5928A, type code 928A, DO-214AC (SMA) package, on the family datasheet 1SMA5913A THRU 1SMA5945A (www.ichjc.com). SHA-256 of the PDF verified: 8200f679467020a5bd7e0853cf057a2984daa6243c5870bb231f0e3b473bd319.
Zener impedance (no dedicated schema slot): ZZT = 7 ohm max at IZT = 28.8 mA; ZZK = 550 ohm max at IZK = 0.25 mA (p. 2, 1SMA5928A row). These support the archetype variant-Z NBV/RS derivation.
Admissible zener current IZM = 115 mA (p. 2, 1SMA5928A row).

Ratings (p. 1): PD = 1500 mW at Tc = 75 degC, VF = 1.5 V at IF = 200 mA, typical RthJA = 250 degC/W, Tj and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. Fig. 1 (p. 3) derates PD linearly from 1.5 W at 75 degC lead temperature to 0 W at about 150 degC.

Curve assessment (p. 3, 400 dpi raster inspected): Fig. 3 'Zener Characteristics (Vz 12V to 68V)' is a family plot with roughly 14 unlabeled branches for 19 family members; the leftmost branch sits near 12 V at low current and the next near 15.5 V, so no branch can be attributed to the 13 V target with confidence. Digitizing was declined rather than guessed.

Fig. 5 'Typical Capacitance' is family-level (capacitance vs breakdown voltage at zero bias and at Vz/2) and its y-axis labels are misprinted (the top and middle decade are both labeled 100), so the axis cannot be calibrated reliably; the electrical table publishes no capacitance value, so capacitance is omitted rather than guessed.

Fig. 6 gives typical dynamic impedance vs Vz at IZ(dc) = 1, 10 and 20 mA, but the target-specific table maxima (ZZT, ZZK) are already recorded above and the figure adds no per-part attribution beyond them.

Forward data: the only forward point is VF = 1.5 V max at IF = 200 mA from the maximum ratings table (p. 1); the datasheet has no forward IV figure, so low-current forward recombination cannot be fitted from this sheet.
No reverse recovery time is published anywhere on the datasheet.
extraction.omission_reason: Curves omitted: all characteristic figures are family-level; Fig. 3 branches are unlabeled and do not map 1:1 to the 19 family members, so no curve is attributable to the 13 V 1SMA5928A, and Fig. 5's misprinted y-axis prevents calibration. Extraction is table-based (F1): VZ min/nom/max at IZT, ZZT/ZZK, IR at VR, IZM, and the VF maximum rating.
